name: Biological Sciences PhD
detailsNote: Official information available. The December 1 deadline is stated as recurring 'each year' with no Fall 2027 date, so it is not confirmed for Fall 2027. Students may join a specific lab directly or rotate, so no single admission model is shown.
summary: PhD in the Department of Biological Sciences at Clemson. Students are admitted either directly to a faculty member's lab or through first-year rotations.

publishedDeadlines.label: Published application deadline (PhD)
publishedDeadlines.note: Department page says the graduate deadline is December 1 "generally for a start in the following fall semester"; no Fall 2027 date is stated. Confirm with the program.

english.toefl: At least 102 (out of 120) with a speaking score above 20 (department); University minimum 4.0 on the new scale
english.note: For international students except those from countries where English is the official language; scores no more than two years old. University minimums are IELTS 6.5 and Duolingo 115; the department asks for more. Degree-based exemptions exist.

applicationFee.note: Clemson's Graduate School says there is no fee to apply.

documents: Statement of purpose (no more than two pages)
Unofficial transcripts from every college or university attended (official ones required on acceptance)
Letters of recommendation (not from the proposed research advisor, who submits a separate letter)
requirements.note: Direct-admission applicants also need a letter of support from the potential advisor.

funding.note: Students can be supported through a teaching assistantship, research assistantship or fellowship; rotation students are supported as teaching assistants in their first year. No stipend amount is given.
